name: Ayasaki Nanoka
source:
The transfer student who sits behind the protagonist, she is a bright and cheerful girl who quickly becomes friends with him. Her hobby is gardening. Because her family is super poor, she wears her sister's old school uniform that is way too big for her. She expresses pity for the school's desolate gardening club, and took on the task of taking care of the flowers. Since it's difficult work and very inconvenient for her to do by herself, the protagonist begun helping her. Together, they are determined to revive the gardening club.

[spoiler]She is the reincarnation of Ayana, the older sister of Konomi who is in love with Haruma. At the end of her route, she gets pregnant and gives birth to the protagonist's child. A daughter who she names Haruno (はるの). Her name Ayasaki Nanoka can be rearrange into Sakakino Ayana.[/spoiler]
